references.text: God's promise to Abraham to give his descendants the land from the River of Egypt to the Euphrates, which is the basis for the promise to expand Israel's borders.
God's promise to Jacob to give him and his descendants the land, and that they will spread out in all directions.
Description of the promised boundaries of Israel's land, from the Red Sea to the Philistine sea and from the wilderness to the Euphrates.
God's promise to expand Israel's borders and drive out the nations before them.
The Lord gives the Israelites the land he swore to give their fathers Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
The promise that every place they set their foot will belong to them, with boundaries from the wilderness to Lebanon and to the Euphrates.
The Lord will expand the territory of the Israelites as he has promised them.
Description of the promised land area that God swore to give to the fathers.
